description: Repairs r-cursor-1/edit-conflict-pessimistic: both Databases came from the default Workspace, so the pessimistic case did not discriminate: B's Edit on A's locked row raised no error and Errors was empty. Cursor B is opened through a second, appended Workspace W2 (CreateWorkspace('W2','admin','',dbUseJet), Workspaces.Append, W2.OpenDatabase of the same file read-write). Cursor A: dynaset on G in the default Workspace with LockEdits True; cursor B: dynaset on G in W2. A Edit row 'r1', set U 'pesA'; B Edit row 'r1', read Errors and EditMode; B MoveNext and Edit row 'r2', read Errors and EditMode, CancelUpdate; A Update, read Errors; B MovePrevious, Edit, set U 'pesB', Update, read Errors, read U; then a new snapshot through each Database reads every row of G. Asks what a pessimistic edit locks, and when the lock is released, across Workspaces. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
